summary: Iter40: per-agent receptionist on own extra number + per-agent business facts (address/hours/notify_email). Backend API + unit tests 10/10 pass; notify_to unit check pass; UI flows (no-number note, own-number panel default ON, sub-toggles, transfer validation/normalization, OFF hides options, persistence after reload, invalid notify email toast) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Reception.jsx useOwnNumber matches any extra number with status != 'liberado' (GET /numbers), so a 'pendiente'/failed extra number also shows the receptionist panel; phone_numbers.assistant_request only routes status 'activo'. Consider filtering by status==='activo' or labelling pending numbers.

vapi.human_rule: when reception ON, reception_message OFF and no transfer_number, the prompt still instructs request_human (and the tool remains available) - acceptable fallback but contradicts the 'Tomar recado' toggle being off.
ReceptionPanel renders null until /numbers resolves (no loading state) - fine, but tests must wait for the selector.
Agent objective 'recepcion' still exists alongside the new receptionist toggle; may confuse users (two ways to be receptionist).
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted tenant_numbers {extra:true, agent_id Marta, +34900000001, TEST_iter40:true} - deleted. Marta fields restored (address/hours/notify_email empty, receptionist/reception_book/reception_message true, transfer_number empty).
